design_rule: Authority belongs to the commissioned action in the current plant context, not to a universal LineAlert job-title assumption.

inspect-presentation-stability.operator_scope: Observe bottle presentation stability from the approved operating position and record the result.
inspect-presentation-stability.verification_requirement: record observation; no material-change verification run required unless a later intervention occurs

verify-guide-spacing.operator_scope: Compare the visible guide / spacing relationship with the commissioned marked or visual reference. Do not adjust during this action.
verify-guide-spacing.verification_requirement: if an out-of-reference condition is observed, rerank before any correction

restore-guide-spacing-to-reference.operator_scope: Only after a current out-of-reference observation, restore guide / spacing to the positively identified approved marked reference. Do not guess a reference or stack another material change before fresh evidence.
restore-guide-spacing-to-reference.verification_requirement: fresh bounded machine evidence required after restoration before another material change or production conclusion
restore-guide-spacing-to-reference.rollback: stop and escalate if the approved reference cannot be positively identified or the bounded restoration cannot be completed as commissioned

repeat-like-for-like.operator_scope: Operator may execute the same-condition bounded run after the shift supervisor authorizes the run conditions.
repeat-like-for-like.rollback: stop the trial and return to the prior approved state if the authorized trial conditions cannot be maintained

request-reduced-speed-trial.operator_scope: Operator may apply only the commissioned temporary diagnostic speed value after supervisor approval. The demo does not define a real speed value.
request-reduced-speed-trial.verification_requirement: fresh bounded verification run required before any other material change
request-reduced-speed-trial.rollback: return to the previously approved operating value according to commissioned procedure

review-label-timing-geometry.verification_requirement: maintenance records evidence; any later adjustment requires its own authority and verification

parameters_notice: This authority profile is synthetic demo policy, not Speedway/OEM guidance or commissioned plant procedure. A real deployment must commission plant-specific permissions by asset, action, operating state, prerequisites, limits, authorization path, verification, and rollback.
